دُمْلُوقٌ : see مَدَمْلَقٌ, in two places. ―
-b2- Also A sort of truffle, (AHn, TA,) smaller than the عُرْجُون, (JK, AHn, K, TA,) the shortest thereof (AHn, TA) found in sands and meadows; (JK, AHn, K, TA;) it is good, (AHn, TA,) and seldom becomes black (JK, AHn, TA) while fresh; (JK;) and it is the sort of which the head is like a مِظَلَّة [q. v.]: (AHn, TA:) pl. دَمَالِيقُ. (JK.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
